description_en: Adds a phone number to a blacklist or deletes a phone number from a blacklist
description_zh: 新增或删除号池黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi operate-black-no --pool-key FC1234560000 --black-no 15000000000 --operate-type AddBlack --tips abcdef --region cn-hangzhou
name: OperateBlackNo

parameters.description_en: The key of the phone number pool. Log on to the [Phone Number Protection console](https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account) and view the key of the phone number pool on the **Number Pool Management** page.
parameters.description_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取**号码池Key**。
parameters.help_en: The key of the phone number pool. Log on to the [Phone Number Protection console](https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account) and view the key of the phone number pool on the **Number Pool Management** page
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取**号码池Key**
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.description_en: The phone number to be added to or deleted from the blacklist.
parameters.description_zh:
需要操作的黑名单号码。
> 仅支持操作**号池黑名单**类型的号码。
parameters.help_en: The phone number to be added to or deleted from the blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的黑名单号码。
> 仅支持操作**号池黑名单**类型的号码
parameters.name: black_no

parameters.description_en:
The type of the operation on the phone number. Valid values:

*   **AddBlack**: adds the phone number to the blacklist.
*   **DeleteBlack**: deletes the phone number from the blacklist.
parameters.description_zh:
黑名单操作类型。取值：

- **AddBlack**：新增黑名单。
- **DeleteBlack**：删除黑名单。
